problem: Canonical brand shell production readback failed after #3788 because production-supersession classified verifier-only files as runtime-affecting, so the current verifier commit could not safely supersede its live ancestor.
rootCause: The runtime applicability contract enumerated verifier-only paths, but production-supersession maintained a separate non-production allowlist that omitted those same paths.
root_cause: The runtime applicability contract enumerated verifier-only paths, but production-supersession maintained a separate non-production allowlist that omitted those same paths.
preventionRule: Every path classified as verifier-only by production-readback authority must also be non-runtime for safe production supersession, while actual website/runtime paths must remain fail-closed.
prevention: Keep verifier-only paths explicit and exact.
Allow ancestor-to-descendant supersession only when every changed path is non-runtime.
Keep HTML, assets, Netlify functions and shared runtime changes unsafe.
Regression-test both allowed verifier-only and blocked runtime descendants.

evaluation.expected: Verifier-only descendants safely supersede a live ancestor; runtime-affecting descendants remain blocked.
